text:
The bug report describes that when picking a contact suggestion, the typed text remains in the input field. After typing "Joh" and clicking the suggestion, element #3 (input#to) still contains "Joh" along with the added contact chip, confirming the bug.

```json
{"action": "finish", "verdict": "REPRODUCED", "reason": "After typing 'Joh' into the To field and clicking the suggested contact, the contact chip ('John Baker') was added, but the typed fragment 'Joh' remained in the input box."}
```
